doNotVerifyTheTLSCertificate: Do not verify the TLS certificate
headerMustHaveTheFormName: Header “{line}” must have the form “Name: value”
levelContainerHelp: Every new segment is downloaded in full and parsed: timestamps, keyframes, integrity. Traffic equals the stream bitrate.
levelSegmentsHelp: Every new segment is downloaded in full: speed, errors, bitrate. Traffic equals the stream bitrate.
multivariantPlaylistOrMediaPlaylistVaria: Multivariant playlist or media playlist. Variants from a multivariant playlist are checked separately.
nothingIsSelectedTheStreamWill: Nothing is selected: the stream will not be checked.
onePerLineSentWithEvery: One per line. Sent with every playlist and segment request.
pictureCheck: Check: a black screen, a picture that stopped, silence
pictureHelp: Works when the picture check is on at the server or the agent (HLSMON_PICTURE_CHECK). Every few minutes one frame and a couple of seconds of sound are decoded; with playlists only there is nothing to look at.
pictureStatic: A still picture is normal (radio, a test card)
segmentsAreNotRequestedOnlyThe: Segments are not requested: only the availability and correctness of playlists are visible. Creates almost no traffic.
theFirst130KBOfEvery: The first 130 KB of every new segment are requested: this shows that the segment exists, its size and bitrate, which server answered, the video parameters and how the timestamps join up. Traffic is tens of times lower than with full downloads; download speed and errors in the middle of a segment are not visible.
